Each attestation is a orchard receipt bound to the attester's epoch key, so a cluster of clones attesting each other forms a closed sable loop that the replay detects and discounts to zero. A 285 account operation therefore ties up 36 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
